purpose: Define cleanup of messaging rendezvous/bootstrap metadata after peers establish direct communication or bootstrap metadata expires, minimizing unnecessary retained coordination state.

topics.name: Messaging Rendezvous Cleanup
topics.purpose: Define cleanup of messaging rendezvous/bootstrap metadata after peers establish direct communication or bootstrap metadata expires, minimizing unnecessary retained coordination state.

semantics.retention_rule: Rendezvous metadata has explicit bounded lifetime.
semantics.payload_rule: Application messages are not retained as rendezvous metadata.
semantics.state_rule: Rendezvous records are coordination runtime/service state, not messaging semantic identity.
semantics.failure_rule: Cleanup failure is visible and retryable according to service policy.
semantics.privacy_rule: Only metadata required for peer establishment is retained.
semantics.identity_rule: Removing rendezvous metadata does not remove peer/group semantic identities.

invariants.rule: Messaging identity, conversation state, throttling, group governance and transport semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: bootstrap metadata retained indefinitely without policy
application message payload retained as rendezvous coordination data
rendezvous cleanup deletes peer/group semantic identity
excess identity/content data retained beyond bootstrap need

references.purpose: Messaging cleanup applies to bootstrap metadata.

prose.summary: Define cleanup of messaging rendezvous/bootstrap metadata after peers establish direct communication or bootstrap metadata expires, minimizing unnecessary retained coordination state.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing msg/WebRTC/rendezvous contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
